title: ""

## Problem

What are you trying to do that TicketHub makes hard or impossible today?
Describe the workflow, not just the missing button.

## Proposed solution

How you imagine it working. Mock-ups, examples from other tools and rough
UI sketches are welcome.

## Alternatives considered

Other ways you have tried to solve this (automations, custom fields, the API,
a manual process).

## Who benefits

- Roles affected: Administrator / Supervisor / Agent / Requester
- Area: tickets / problems / changes / assets / catalog / knowledge base /
  portal / email / SSO / API / reporting / other

## Additional context

Anything else — links to related issues, screenshots, constraints.
